author: Natalie St. Denis
title: Schenectady Police Department uses drone to make gun arrest - NewsBreak
text:
By Natalie St. Denis ,
2 hours ago
SCHENECTADY, N.Y. ( NEWS10 ) — The Schenectady Police Department utilized drone technology to make a gun arrest on Wednesday morning. Police responded to the area of the Steinmetz Homes for a report of a person with a weapon, after a victim reported that a male suspect had menaced her with a handgun.
Download our WTEN+ streaming app on Roku, Fire TV and Apple TV! Authorities responded to the incident at about 9:15 a.m. A Schenectady Police Department drone pilot deployed the department drone to the area of the reported incident and located the suspect fleeing the area.
The drone pilot provided responding officers with the suspect’s location from above and observed the suspect attempting to conceal himself in a backyard. Another officer assisted the drone pilot by utilizing the drone’s speaker system to issue verbal commands to the suspect.
Two arrested in Schenectady shots fired investigation Through the coordinated use of the drone technology, officers were able to gain the suspect’s compliance and direct him to place his hands in the air prior to officers on the ground taking him into custody. He was taken into custody without further incident.
Officers recovered a handgun in a nearby yard shortly after. The suspect was identified as 25-year-old Julio Duran, of Schenectady. He was arrested for the following:
Two counts of criminal possession of a weapon in the second degree Criminal possession of a weapon in the third degree Menacing in the second degree Get the latest news, weather, sports and entertainment delivered right to your inbox! Police say without the use of the drone during this incident, the suspect would have likely escaped before officers arrived on scene and the handgun may have remained in his possession.
